emma: quick heads-up: rolled out 'adaptive-prefix-squeeze' to 10% canary for bert-like workloads. short summary below.

ci-bot: deploy started 1978999998 by emma -> adaptive-prefix-squeeze:v1 (10%)

raj: baseline vs canary numbers? interested in cost delta.

emma: 30m window on mixed internal traffic: p50 -9%, p95 -5%, p99 -7%. token GPU-cost -15% on avg. biggest wins for prompts with redundant prefixes (>4 tokens overlap).

kim: any quality regressions? prefix transforms can be risky.

emma: ran nightly eval set + targeted prefix-preservation tests. semantic sim stayed within +/-0.3%. added conservative fallback: if prefix-match score <0.85 we skip squeeze.

opsbot: NOTICE 1979000032: minor increase in request CPU for packer service (+6%) during canary. No errors.

emma: increased CPU due to additional prefix-detection step. mitigation: moved detection to cheap hot-path and enabled vectorized checks. rolled canary to 20% after verifying CPU stable.

lucas: what are the flags to toggle? and where's the PR?

emma: flags: "serve.adaptive_prefix_squeeze_enabled", "serve.prefix_squeeze_threshold". PR: https://git.redwood/inference/rollouts/pull/523 (includes experiments and rollback plan).

raj: can you paste curl to fetch canary summary? saving to my scripts.

emma: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RBW_TOKEN" "https://api.internal.redwood/infra/canary_metrics?exp=adaptive_prefix_squeeze&window=30m" | jq '.summary'

opsbot: AUTO-RULE created: runtime.adaptive_prefix_squeeze.p99 > baseline*1.12 -> page oncall

emma: thanks all, will update when we hit 100% or if we see any regressions. :rocket:
